relations.subject: Hammalava Saddhātissa
relations.evidence: After his ordination as a novice in 1926 under the name of Hammalava Saddhātissa, he joined the Sastrodoya Piriveņa, Sandalankāva, where he continued his primary and secondary education

relations.subject: Hammalava Saddhātissa
relations.evidence: Thereafter he joined the Vidyodaya Pirivena, Māligākanda, the reputed seat of oriental learning... He passed the final Examination of the Vidyodaya Pirivena in Pali, Sanskrit, Prakrit, Sinhala, Buddhism and History, ob- taining a first class in the year 1939.

relations.subject: Hammalava Saddhātissa
